tagline: Brazil's postcard city wraps golden beaches, jungle-covered peaks and samba around two of the world's most famous viewpoints: Christ the Redeemer and Sugarloaf Mountain. It is ranked #12 on Time Out's Best Cities 2026 list.
overview: Founded by the Portuguese in 1565 where Guanabara Bay meets the Atlantic, Rio served as Brazil's capital for nearly two centuries. The city squeezed between ocean and granite peaks grew into one of the most dramatic urban settings on Earth, celebrated in bossa nova and samba.

The icons live up to the hype. The 38-metre Christ the Redeemer statue spreads its arms over the city from Corcovado Mountain, and the cable car up Sugarloaf delivers the classic panorama of bay, beaches and forested hills. Down at sea level, Copacabana and Ipanema run for kilometres along a mosaic promenade.

Carnival turns the city upside down each February or March, but the rhythm runs all year in the samba clubs of Lapa and the street parties called blocos. Between the forest trails of Tijuca, the murals of Olympic Boulevard and a caipirinha at sunset on Arpoador rock, Rio rewards long stays.

funFacts.title: A NEW WONDER OF THE WORLD
funFacts.text: Christ the Redeemer was voted one of the New Seven Wonders of the World in 2007.

funFacts.title: AN URBAN RAINFOREST
funFacts.text: Tijuca National Park is one of the largest urban forests on Earth, replanted by hand in the 1800s.

funFacts.title: THE WORLD'S BIGGEST PARTY
funFacts.text: Rio's Carnival draws around 2 million people a day onto the streets.

faq.q: Where is Rio de Janeiro located?
faq.a: Rio de Janeiro is in Brazil, in South America.

faq.q: What is the population of Rio de Janeiro?
